en.ic.story.s1.text: One morning, a small paper boat floated into the garden pond. Inside was a tiny map.
en.ic.story.s1.n1: The map led to a hidden door under the old oak tree.
en.ic.story.s1.n2: A friendly frog read the map out loud.
en.ic.story.s1.n3: The map began to glow softly.
en.ic.story.s1.e1: Behind the door was a room full of gentle music.
en.ic.story.s1.e2: They found a new friend and shared a picnic.
en.ic.story.s1.e3: They decided to make their own map for someone else.
en.ic.story.s2.text: A little robot woke up in a quiet workshop. It had never seen the sun before.
en.ic.story.s2.n1: It rolled slowly toward the open window.
en.ic.story.s2.n2: A bird landed on the sill and said hello.
en.ic.story.s2.n3: It found a flower in a pot and wondered what it was.
en.ic.story.s2.e1: The robot felt the warm sun and smiled for the first time.
en.ic.story.s2.e2: The bird showed the robot the whole sky.
en.ic.story.s2.e3: The robot took care of the flower every day.
en.ic.story.s3.text: On a very rainy day, a dragon who was afraid of puddles sat at the cave door.
en.ic.story.s3.n1: A small hedgehog came by with a bright yellow umbrella.
en.ic.story.s3.n2: The dragon watched the raindrops make tiny circles.
en.ic.story.s3.n3: The dragon tried one slow step toward the rain.
en.ic.story.s3.e1: They splashed together and giggled all afternoon.
en.ic.story.s3.e2: The dragon decided puddles are just small mirrors.
en.ic.story.s3.e3: They stayed cozy inside and invented a rain song.
en.ic.story.s4.text: At the edge of the night sky, a little star was feeling very small.
en.ic.story.s4.n1: A comet zoomed past and waved.
en.ic.story.s4.n2: The moon whispered, "I have an idea."
en.ic.story.s4.n3: The star noticed that other tiny stars were nearby.
en.ic.story.s4.e1: Together they made a shape that everyone on Earth could see.
en.ic.story.s4.e2: The star learned that small lights matter.
en.ic.story.s4.e3: The star shone brightly in its own special way.
